name: Olivares de Duero (Spain)
description: Light blue field with a white chevron pointing to the fly, charged at the hoist with a yellow castle.
history: Municipal flag of Olivares de Duero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron issuing from the fly corners and pointing to the hoist
castle with red door and windows
door and windows of the castle
